get.summary:
* GET /api/v0/exercise-services/client/courses
 *
 * Returns the courses that the user is currently enrolled on that contain exercises this
 * client can be served.

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

200.description: The courses the user is enrolled on that contain client-servable exercises

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

get.summary:
* GET /api/v0/exercise-services/client/courses/:id
 *
 * Returns the course with the given id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Course id

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

403.description: The token lacks the `exercise-services` scope, or the user may not view this course

404.description: No course with the given id exists

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

get.summary:
* GET /api/v0/exercise-services/client/courses/:id/exercises
 *
 * Returns the user's exercise slides for the given course.
 * Does not return anything for chapters which are not open yet.
 * Selects slides for exercises with no slide selected yet.
 * Only returns slides which have tasks whose exercise service can serve this client.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Course id

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

200.description: The user's client-servable exercise slides for open chapters

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

403.description: The token lacks the `exercise-services` scope, or the user may not view this course

404.description: No course with the given id exists

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

get.summary:
* GET /api/v0/exercise-services/client/courses/:id/progress
 *
 * Returns the current user's progress on every exercise of the course that lives in an
 * open chapter (the same visibility as `courses/:id/exercises`): its awarded and maximum
 * points and completed/attempted signals. One round-trip; course totals are derivable by
 * summing the returned entries.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Course id

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

200.description: The user's per-exercise progress for the course's open chapters

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

403.description: The token lacks the `exercise-services` scope, or the user may not view this course

404.description: No course with the given id exists

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

get.summary:
* GET /api/v0/exercise-services/client/exercises/:id
 *
 * Returns an exercise slide for the user for the given exercise.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exercise id

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

200.description: An exercise slide for the user, carrying only the tasks whose exercise service can serve this client

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

403.description: The token lacks the `exercise-services` scope, or the user may not view this exercise

404.description: No exercise with the given id exists, it belongs to an exam (not served by this API), or no task of it can serve this client

422.description: The user is not enrolled to this exercise's course (message_key `not_enrolled`)

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

post.summary:
* POST /api/v0/exercise-services/client/exercises/:id/files
 *
 * Stores files for a later submission to this exercise. Every multipart field name must be a
 * UUID the client picks; the host assigns the ids a submit request then names. Uploads are
 * bound to this exercise and user, and unreferenced ones are reaped, so a client should upload
 * immediately before submitting.
 *
 * Gated on the caller being able to answer the exercise at all, so stored objects cannot be
 * accumulated past a deadline or a closed exam. The per-slide try limit is only checked across the
 * whole exercise here, because this route is bound to an exercise rather than a slide.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exercise id

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

requestBody.description: One file part per file, each field name a distinct client-chosen UUID and each part carrying a file name

200.description: The stored files, in the order the parts were sent

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

403.description: The token lacks the `exercise-services` scope, or the user may not view this exercise

404.description: No exercise with the given id exists

422.description: The user is not enrolled to this exercise's course (message_key `not_enrolled`), the exercise can no longer be answered because its deadline has passed or every slide is out of tries, or the multipart body violates the field-name, file-count or size rules

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

get.summary:
* GET /api/v0/exercise-services/client/exercises/:id/submissions
 *
 * Returns the current user's past submissions to the given exercise, newest
 * first, each annotated with its grading score and progress if graded.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exercise id

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

200.description: The current user's submissions to the exercise, newest first

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

post.summary:
* POST /api/v0/exercise-services/client/exercises/:id/submit
 *
 * Accepts an exercise submission from the user. A `file` answer names files previously stored
 * through this exercise's `files` endpoint, in the order they are to be graded; those files are the
 * answer. An answer that names no files is a JSON answer, carried in `data_json`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exercise id

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

requestBody.description: The slide and task being answered, and the answer: its JSON, the ids of the files it consists of, or both

200.description: The created submission, identified by both its task and slide submission ids

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

403.description: The token lacks the `exercise-services` scope, or the user may not view this exercise

404.description: No exercise with the given id exists, or the referenced slide/task does not exist

422.description: The user is not enrolled to this exercise's course (message_key `not_enrolled`), the referenced slide/task belongs to another exercise, the task's exercise service cannot be served to this client, a `file` answer names no files or a `json` one names files, or a named upload was reaped (`upload_expired`), was never uploaded for this exercise by this user (`unknown_upload`) or was named more than once (`duplicate_upload`)

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

get.summary:
* GET /api/v0/exercise-services/client/submissions/:id/download
 *
 * Resolves an exercise-slide submission (by the id returned from the submissions list, or by
 * a submit's `slide_submission_id`) to the files it was made from, so the client can restore
 * an old submission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exercise-slide-submission id

parameters.name: X-Client-Version
parameters.description: Optional client version; obsolete clients get 426

200.description: The files the submission was made from, in the order they were recorded; the same shape whether the submission came from a native client or the service's IFrame

401.description: The bearer token is missing or was rejected

404.description: No submission with the given id exists

426.description: The client is obsolete and must be upgraded

AnswerFile.description:
A file the host stored on a client's behalf. The host assigns `id`; a client never invents
one. Returned by the upload endpoint and echoed back by submission download.

id.description: The host's file id. Names this file in a submit request.

name.description: The original file name the client sent.

order_number.description:
The file's position in the answer it belongs to. `None` for a file that is not part of an
answer yet, which is every file the upload endpoint returns.

size_bytes.description:
`None` for a file stored before the size was recorded; never a substitute zero, so a client
can tell an unknown size from an empty file.

url.description: Direct download URL; needs no bearer token.

AnswerKind.description:
Which of the two representations an answer is: the JSON in `data_json`, or the files in
`data_files`. A request that omits it means `Json`.

ApiErrorResponse.description: Canonical API error envelope returned for controlled application errors.

Course.description: A course the current user can browse or is enrolled in.

organization_name.description: Denormalized so a client needn't resolve the owning organization separately.

CourseProgress.description:
The current user's progress across every exercise they can see in a course, returned
by `courses/{id}/progress` in a single round-trip. Course-level totals are not sent
separately; the client derives them by summing over `exercises` (e.g. total awarded =
`sum(score_given)`, total available = `sum(score_maximum)`).

course_id.description: The course these progress entries belong to; echoes the path id.

ExerciseProgress.description:
The current user's progress on a single exercise.

A client derives a boolean "passed" from these fields. The authoritative signal is
`completed` (the exercise reached the `Completed` activity stage). A client that
instead treats "full points" as passing can use `score_given >= score_maximum` when
`score_maximum > 0`.

attempted.description:
`true` once the user has started or submitted the exercise (any activity stage past
the initial one), regardless of whether it is completed.

completed.description:
`true` once the exercise has reached the `Completed` activity stage. The primary
"passed" signal.

score_given.description: Points the user has been awarded, `0.0` when the user has no state for the exercise.

score_maximum.description: The maximum points obtainable from the exercise.

ExerciseSlide.description:
One selected slide of an exercise, carrying only the tasks whose exercise service can serve
the requesting client. An exercise with no client-servable task is omitted entirely by
endpoints that return this type, rather than appearing with an empty `tasks`.

course_id.description: The course the exercise belongs to, so a client need not resolve it separately.

ExerciseSlideSubmission.description:
Body of `POST exercises/{id}/submit`. Plain JSON — no file parts, no archive: the previously
uploaded files named here are the answer.

oneOf.description: Absent means `json`. A client answering with files sends `file`.

data_files.description:
Ids from this exercise's `files` endpoint, in the order they are to be graded and
displayed. A `file` answer must name at least one, and every id must have been uploaded by
this user for this exercise.

data_json.description:
The exercise service's own JSON: the whole answer for a `json` answer, the service's
metadata about the files for a `file` one.

ExerciseSlideSubmissionListItem.description:
A past submission of the current user to an exercise. `id` is the
exercise-slide-submission id, which is what `submissions/{id}/download` takes.

ExerciseTask.description:
One task of an exercise slide, as produced by a specific exercise service.

`public_spec` / `model_solution_spec` are plugin-owned blobs: the exercise service
that produces them is the only component that interprets their shape, so the host
forwards them verbatim and they stay opaque `serde_json::Value` here.

ExerciseTaskSubmissionResult.description:
Result of a submit. Carries both ids so a client never re-derives one from the other:
grading polling takes `task_submission_id`, download/share take `slide_submission_id`.

feedback_json.description:
Structured grading feedback, opaque like `ExerciseTask`'s spec fields: only the
exercise service that produced it interprets its shape.

feedback_text.description: Human-readable feedback, for a client to display as-is.

score_given.description:
Absent until grading has produced a value; a partial value while `grading_progress`
is still pending.

ExerciseTaskSubmissionStatus.description: The grading status of a task submission, as polled after `submit`.

GradingProgress.description: How far along a task submission's grading is.

PasteResult.description: A shareable URL for a submission.

SubmissionFiles.description:
Response of `GET submissions/{id}/download`: the files the submission was made from, recovered
from the host's own file records rather than from the service's answer.

The same shape regardless of where the submission was made. A native client's uploads are
recorded as it names them; an answer made in the service's IFrame carries its files inside the
service's own answer, so the host asks the service to enumerate them and stores them the same
way. Empty only when the submission genuinely has no files — an exercise type with none, or a
service that declares no way to enumerate its answers' files.

UploadedFiles.description: Response of `POST exercises/{id}/files`, in the same order as the request's parts.

bearer_auth.description: Access token passed as an HTTP bearer token in the Authorization header.
